product.title: Seattle's Original Guided Harbor Cruise

description.text: Cruise Elliott Bay and Seattle Harbor on a one-hour narrated boat tour departing from Pier 55. The route offers skyline views, shipping-terminal perspectives, and mountain backdrops including the Cascades, Olympics, and Mount Rainier when visible.

highlights: One-hour narrated Elliott Bay harbor cruise
Depart from Pier 55 on the Seattle waterfront
Views of the skyline, Great Wheel, and Space Needle
See one of the world's largest shipping terminals

start.description: Board at Pier 55, 1101 Alaskan Way, Seattle, WA 98101.

end.description: Return to Pier 55 after the harbor loop.

product.itinerarySummary: Cruise Elliott Bay and Seattle Harbor on a one-hour narrated boat tour departing from Pier 55.

itineraryItems.title: Pier 55 departure
itineraryItems.description: Board the vessel at the Seattle waterfront before the narrated harbor loop begins.

itineraryItems.title: Elliott Bay
itineraryItems.description: Cruise Elliott Bay with commentary on Seattle's waterfront history and harbor operations.

itineraryItems.title: Seattle skyline
itineraryItems.description: View the city skyline, Great Wheel, and Space Needle from open-water perspectives.

itineraryItems.title: Shipping terminal
itineraryItems.description: Pass one of the largest container shipping terminals on the West Coast.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
